messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 SLO breach for customer NIMBUS on dedicated-pool eu1. Auto-warroom opened. Severity: Sev2. Link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/4105007777 :rotating_light:
oncall-elaine: Acked. Paging primary on-call Sandeep. I'm jumping in now.
sandeep: I’m on it. seeing p95 ~420ms -> 980ms p99 over last 5m. spikes aligned with batch jobs from tenant "nimbus-analytics".
marisa: FYI I just opened a support bridge with customer SRE (see below). They report timeouts in their auth flow. Customer impact: pages, real user errors.
customer-sre-nimbus: Confirming — we started seeing 502/504 at 13:04 UTC. A subset of requests (large context, embeddings) time out. Impacting 20% of traffic. We can divert if you need.
eng-runtime-taylor: Initial telemetry: KV cache hit rate dropped ~30% for that pool, memory pressure on nodes, OOM-kill of one worker ~ 13:08 UTC. Likely degraded batching causing backlog.
eng-sre-ivan: Can we isolate tenant traffic to reduce head-of-line blocking? Recommend tenant eviction to warm spare pool or rate-limit heavy keys.
ops-voice: Running tenant isolation playbook: `/runbook tenant_isolate --customer nimbus --tenant nimbus-analytics --target eu2-warm-spare`
ops-voice: Executing routing change now: `redwood route update --customer nimbus --pool eu1 --exclude-tenant nimbus-analytics --fallback eu2 --dry-run false`
incident-bot: Action logged. ChangeID: chi_4105000777. Notifying infra autoscaler to add 2 instances to dedicated pool eu1.
sandeep: Applying temporary rate limit to analytics tenant: `rate-limit set nimbus-analytics 25rps` — doing this to relieve tail latency.
eng-runtime-taylor: Also enabling fallback model variant for long-context requests: `model-route set --customer nimbus --path /generate --fallback redwood/gpt-base-quant-v1` — reduces memory and KV pressure.
marisa: Customer notified: "We’re routing some analytics traffic to a warm spare region and applying temporary limits. Expect improved latencies within 10-15m. We’ll update in 5m."
customer-sre-nimbus: Thanks. We’re prepared to shift traffic for the analytics job schedule if you want full cutover.
eng-sre-ivan: We saw one worker OOM due to a runaway decoder loop; I’ve blacklisted the process and drained that node. Adding evict command: `kubectl cordon node-xyz && kubectl drain node-xyz --ignore-daemonsets`
ops-voice: Node cordoned and drained. Autoscaler request accepted. +2 instances provisioning ETA ~6m.
incident-bot: Metrics alert: p95 decreased from 420ms -> 260ms in next 4m after rate-limit. p99 still at ~420ms. Keep monitoring.
sandeep: Good improvement. Next step: if p99 not back under SLO, we do full traffic cutover of analytics to eu2 warm spare and increase pool capacity further.
eng-runtime-taylor: Also pushing small config tweak: reduce batch max tokens for that pool to 512 to prevent excessive memory in single batches. Command: `redwood config set pool:eu1 batch.max_tokens=512`
marisa: Customer asked for timeline and root-cause update. Drafting message: "We've isolated the high-memory analytics workload and routed it to a warm spare; we've added capacity and applied throttles. We're continuing to monitor and will confirm when p99 is below your SLO."
customer-sre-nimbus: Acknowledged. They also asked for logs for the 13:04-13:12 window. I’ll upload when you’re ready.
eng-sre-ivan: Will capture crash logs and kernel OOM traces and push to secure share: `s3://redwood-incident-logs/4105007777/`
ops-voice: Warm-spare routing complete. Weighting: eu2=0.4 for analytics traffic.
incident-bot: Post-change metrics: p95=240ms, p99=310ms. Error rate 502s down from 2.1% -> 0.6%.
shift-lead-jane: Good mitigation. Keep the bridge open. Sandeep, can you do a quick postmortem stub and assign owners?
sandeep: On it. Preliminary RCA hypothesis: memory-pressure-induced batching backpressure from analytics tenant + suboptimal cache eviction. Action items: 1) customer-side: stagger huge batch jobs; 2) platform-side: add tenant-level QoS, improve cache eviction, add OOM alerting per pool.
marisa: I’ll coordinate customer follow-up and ask for their async logs.
eng-runtime-taylor: Will open an internal ticket to rollback batch.strategy for eu1 if we see regressions.
customer-sre-nimbus: Traffic looks stable now from our side. We'll provide logs and can test cutover back when ready.
incident-bot: Warroom status: MITIGATION IN PROGRESS -> p99 trending down. Incident channel will be used for updates.
shift-lead-jane: Handoff plan: Sandeep, please leave a clear status and owners in the incident board. I’ll take next 2h monitoring and escalate if regressions.
sandeep: Leaving notes and owners. Closing initial warroom phase in 30m if no regressions. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
